name: Fairmont Jakarta
short_description: A 488-room hotel in Senayan Square, opened January 2015, with 108 Sky Suites, a 900-square-metre Willow Stream Spa, and views of Gelora Bung Karno stadium.
ai_summary: Fairmont Jakarta opened in January 2015 in the prestigious Senayan Square area of Jakarta's south business district, comprising 488 rooms including 108 dedicated Sky Suites, many with views over Gelora Bung Karno stadium. The hotel's 900-square-metre Willow Stream Spa and 1,200-square-metre Grand Ballroom anchor its wellness and events offering, alongside Spectrum's extensive breakfast buffet blending Indonesian and Western dishes. Guests consistently praise the spacious, immaculately clean rooms and the strategic location near shopping and entertainment, though some Accor elite members report inconsistent recognition of their status, and value can vary with unexpected charges reported by a subset of travelers.

faqs.question: When did Fairmont Jakarta open?
faqs.answer: January 2015, in the prestigious Senayan Square area of Jakarta's south business district -- the hotel comprises 488 rooms including 108 dedicated Sky Suites, many with views over Gelora Bung Karno stadium.

faqs.question: Does Fairmont Jakarta have a spa?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the 900-square-metre Willow Stream Spa is one of the larger hotel spas in Jakarta, complementing the property's 1,200-square-metre Grand Ballroom for guests combining leisure and events.
